message.content: {"caption":"WikiSkill’s layered knowledge architecture and iterative skill-improvement workflow.","description":"A process diagram shows three horizontal knowledge layers above a four-step workflow. The Skill Layer (skills/) contains evolving procedural knowledge and is marked “Reversible, Conditional Update”; the Wiki Layer (wiki/) holds structured patterns and evolution logs and is marked “Compounding, Never Reset”; and the Raw Layer (raw/) stores immutable execution traces and is marked “Permanent, Write Once.” Below, Step 1, Inference Agent, executes rollouts on the training set and injects skills; Step 2, Wiki Maintainer, samples traces and consolidates patterns through root-cause analysis; Step 3, Skill Proposer, reads skills, wiki, and traces to propose skill updates; and Step 4, Gating & Rollback, evaluates candidates on the validation set and updates skills if better and wiki logs. Arrows connect the steps and layers, with a return arrow labeled “Next Iteration” looping from the final step to the first.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
